question: Which company has recorded lowest range in production figures between 1996 and 2000?
solution:
**Given:**

In the given graph, data is given for paper production in different years by 3 companies X, Y and Z.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/255409c20c7fc5166c51fb5cb753bda1f7c31faf2ed2aec2c54a0901d725a904.png] 

**Calculations:**

Range of Production of company X between year 1996 to 2000 = 25 to 50 

Range of Production of company Y between year 1996 to 2000 = 25 to 50

Range of Production of company Z between year 1996 to 2000 = 35 to 45

Hence, Company Z has the lowest production range.
